doorRisk.why: runTapeEnvelopeForContract(e9-dome-basin) -> maxTapeBytes 1938784 B; this reel is 3230134 B (1.67x). Ticks and entries both pass (lastEntryTick 17999 < durationTicks 18000 <= 18002; entries 926 <= 3601). The breach is BYTES ONLY.
doorRisk.cause: The board emits a surprise view about every 1.5 s once the harvest tail starts failing on depleted seams, and every one of those 926 views was answered with a fresh 32-order array at ~3.5 KB. The play is sound; the SUBMISSION RATE is what breaches.
doorRisk.cure: Identical policy plus a submission floor: answer a view with a blank line (gr-sim records no entry) unless pendingOffer is live, a BUILD is emittable, or ~4 s of sim time has passed since the last accepted array. That cuts ~926 entries to ~340 and the reel to ~1.2 MB with no change to the orders themselves. NOT RIDDEN: the stop rule ends the heat at the first SECURED outcome, which this run is.
